<cite ref="Chullin 98a:7">Ḥull. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>ההוא כז׳ וכ׳</he> fat of the size of an olive.
<cite ref="Chullin 98a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>פלגא דז׳</he> half the size of &c.; <he>תלתין פלגין דז׳</he> thirty times the size of half an olive.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:13:3">Y. Pes. VII, 35ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>כז׳ פסחא וכ׳</he> with an olive’s size of the Passover meat (for each participant), the Hallel (sung on the roof) seems to burst the roof (i.e. joy in simplicity is the purest); Bab.

<cite ref="Pesachim 85b">Pes. 85ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:14:7">Cant. R. to II, 14</cite> <he>פסחא בבייתא</he> (read <he>כז׳</he>).—Pl. <he>זיתִין</he>, <he>זֵיתַיָּא</he>, <he>זיתֵי</he>.
